title: Unread filter
blurb: The sidebar Unread filter and the All Account Mail Unread row list downloaded unread mail. Opening an unread message may mark it read and keeps that one row in the list until a different unread message is opened. Opening a message that is already read, opening the held row again, or highlighting a row without opening it leaves the hold. Mark read on the held row from the row button leaves it listed. Mark unread clears the hold and the row stays because it is unread. Mark read on a row that is not held removes it immediately. Multi-select Mark read removes every selected row immediately, including the held row when it is selected, even when only that row is selected. A held row outside the selection stays. Leaving Unread, switching folder or account, searching, or turning the filter off clears the hold, and coming back does not restore it. Refresh and Sync keep the held row unless the message is gone from that filtered mail. Other filters do not keep a read row this way.
